description: Works including Second Floor: Dismantle bathroom and shower room to form one bathroom. New window to rear. First Floor: Block up opening between front reception and rear reception, reinstate landing door to rear reception. Replace French casement windows to front reception. Brick up existing window in closet wing overlooking side return. Reposition stir treads to rear half landing room. Formation of new shower room and ttility room to rear half landing room. Ground Floor: Dismantle kitchen in rear reception. Reinstatement of original opening form rear reception to rear side return with French doors. Reinstatement of door from hall to rear reception. Dismantle shower room in rear closet wing. Dismantle window to form new French doors to rear side return. Formation of new kitchen in rear closet wing. Enlargement of existing kitchen window over looking rear side return. New flat roof with glazed roof lantern. New slate roof.
